words.sense: A fixed sequence of spoken words believed to have special power in a ritual
misconceptions: Every ritual line is an incantation
Spoken volume or ceremony alone determines the label

words.sense: A direct appeal calling on a deity or spirit for help or presence
misconceptions: Every mention of a spirit is an invocation
Spoken volume or ceremony alone determines the label

semantic_axes.description: Whether the scene turns on mechanism of words.
Whether the scene turns on addressee.

edges.boundary_rule: An incantation is a spoken formula believed powerful in itself; an invocation directly calls upon a deity or spirit.

misconceptions.M1: Every ritual line is an incantation
misconceptions.M2: Every mention of a spirit is an invocation
misconceptions.M3: Spoken volume or ceremony alone determines the label

beats.text: Rina’s character repeats a fixed rhyme, believing that each syllable itself unlocks the enchanted door.
beats.decisive_clue: fixed words believed to unlock door
beats.reason: The detail about fixed words believed to unlock door supports incantation more strongly than invocation.

beats.text: She must say the syllables in exactly the right order; she asks no being for assistance.
beats.reason: The detail about power tied to exact order supports incantation more strongly than invocation.

chains.feedback_short: Power tied to exact order leaves incantation the better fit.
chains.feedback_deep: The first clue is fixed words believed to unlock door. The later clue is power tied to exact order; that strengthens or preserves the same classification. An incantation is a spoken formula believed powerful in itself; an invocation directly calls upon a deity or spirit.
